description:
Workspace AGENTS.md mandates: 'The only permitted markdown planning artifact is a crate's PLAN.md, which is a permanent design document checked into the repo, not a scratchpad.'

PLAN.md in crate-jmap-base-client has drifted away from this contract. Drift evidence:

1. Lines 36-55: 'Source Material' section with a per-file extraction recipe ('Rename JmapChatClient → JmapClient', 'remove Chat-specific methods'). The extraction is done. This is a historical bootstrap artifact.

2. Lines 51-55: 'Key simplification: src/jmap.rs in jmapchat-client redefines Id, UTCDate, JmapRequest, JmapResponse, Invocation, ResultReference, and Session from scratch [...] Delete the redundant definitions.' Past-tense instructions to a doer who completed the work months ago.

3. Lines 59-69: Dependencies block lists 'reqwest = { version = "0.12", features = [json, stream, rustls-tls-webpki-roots] }', 'tokio = { features = ["rt"] }', 'tokio-tungstenite = "0.29"'. Actual Cargo.toml uses workspace inheritance and feature lists do not match (e.g. tokio = { features = ["time"] }). The PLAN.md is prescribing dependencies that no longer reflect reality.

4. Lines 71-73: 'Note: jmapchat-client also pulls in chrono, base64, sha2, ulid. Audit these after extraction — several likely exist only because the client redefined types that are now in jmap-types or jmap-chat-types.' The audit happened (base64 and sha2 survived, the others did not). Note has never been removed.

5. Lines 75-82: 'Impact on jmap-chat-client' section is a forward-looking plan for a crate that has long since absorbed those changes.

6. Lines 84-99: 'Module Layout' lists 'auth.rs blob.rs client.rs error.rs request.rs sse.rs ws/mod.rs'. Missing push.rs which actually exists in src/. Lines 122-129 of the same PLAN.md DO reference src/push.rs, so the file is known — but the canonical Module Layout block is wrong.

7. Lines 161-169: 'Test Strategy' bullets read as a to-do list for someone implementing tests, not as documentation of the test strategy that exists.

The Extras-preservation section at lines 101-159 is current and design-doc-worthy. The rest is scratchpad.

Fix: delete the historical extraction recipe (Source Material, Key simplification, Impact on jmap-chat-client sections), update the Dependencies block to match Cargo.toml or replace with 'see Cargo.toml', update Module Layout to include push.rs, and either delete the Test Strategy bullets or replace with a description of what is actually tested.
title: PLAN.md drifted into scratchpad: extraction recipe, stale deps, obsolete forward-looking sections
